trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (mean on pool2) with score 0.0028, and the verdict is "indistinguishable" — the runner-up is not statistically better. action_args.justification: The series has a strong trend (0.88) and strong seasonality (0.61) with moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.478). The mean over the 7 most consistently-ranked models (pool2) already achieves RMSE 115.3, well below the best single model (rf, 128.9), indicating genuine complementarity among the top models. With only 3 validation windows, fitted weights carry high estimation variance, and the 'indistinguishable' verdict confirms no strategy in the history is statistically superior. The simple mean is the most robust choice given the redundancy groups (DWT_rf/ONLY_DWT_rf, CWT_catboost/DWT_catboost) and the moderate ranking instability.
